newsitem.title: USA: Ramsay Managed Care sees Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Ramsay Managed Care sees Q4 charge.

text.p: Ramsay Managed Care Inc said it expected to record a one-time noncash pretax charge against earnings of $2.7 million for write-offs in the fourth quarter ended June 30.
In addition, a $5.3 million reserve will also be booked in the quarter in relation the the company's investment in the HMO operations, it said.
The company plans to announce results for the fiscal year ended June 30 after completion of its annual audit in mid-September.
The company also announced plans to move corporate headquarters from New Orleans to Miami, with the transition completed in 90 days.
